name: codemax-cli
description: One terminal harness for many coding-agent CLIs. Switch between Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Grok and more without losing project context.

scripts.build: bun build --compile --minify src/cli.ts --outfile dist/codemax && (test "$(uname)" != Darwin || codesign --force --sign - dist/codemax)
